tolerance.basis: closed form for prismatic infinite beam on homogeneous Winkler foundation

source.doc: Hetenyi, M., 'Beams on Elastic Foundation', University of Michigan Press (1946), infinite beam under a concentrated load
source.table: w(x) = (P beta / 2k) exp(-beta x)(cos beta x + sin beta x), beta = (k/(4EI))^(1/4)
source.access_note: closed form from the monograph; page not re-verified offline

sha256_scope: sha256 over the archived digitisation artefact (sources/hetenyi1946.beam_influence_infinite.csv), i.e. the byte-exact table this entry serves; no page image of the source document is held in-repo, so the anchor does not claim pixel-level provenance

validity_range.note: digitised to beta x <= 2 (deflection already 2.4% of w_max); the sign change at beta x = 3 pi/4 is outside the table and refused

dual_pass.note: pass A = machine-precision transcription of the published closed form; pass B = re-typed at printed precision (5-6 s.f.) with an independent format convention. Human double-keying is NOT claimed.

verification.method: finite-difference solution of the fourth-derivative beam equation with 4w on u in [-10,10] (n=2001, n=4001) vs Hetenyi closed form w(0) = P beta/(2k) = 1/8

notes: Non-dimensional influence coefficient: multiply by P beta/(2k) to obtain the deflection.
